title: Training Beyond Technical Skills
description: Technical competency alone does not guarantee international success. SLEDMC Academy delivers a 360-degree curriculum combining professional aptitude, language mastery, European culture, worker rights, and pre-departure readiness.

pillars.title: Language & Workplace Communication
pillars.desc: Destination-specific language training focused on practical workplace dialogues, safety instructions, and supervisor interaction.

pillars.title: European Culture & Work Ethic
pillars.desc: Deep orientation into European work culture, punctuality, gender equality, workplace safety, and civic norms.

pillars.title: Rights & Fraud Protection
pillars.desc: Thorough education on employment contracts, working hour laws, fair wages, tax compliance, and anti-recruitment fraud.

pillars.title: Verified Qualification Pathways
pillars.desc: Structuring candidate documents, trade certifications, and facilitating legal pathways for European regulated licenses.
